title: Church of Mount Bokor
scope: Standing Bokor plateau chapel in its documented pre-restoration appearance, with the weathered nave, concrete vault, entrance tower and adjacent open ruin.
limitations: The model reflects the 2020 condition and the permanent features confirmed in 2026, before restoration. Estimated roof, wall and tower heights follow proportions in the exact photos.
The weathered stone and orange moss are represented procedurally. Interior furnishings, plant growth, temporary work and proposed restoration are outside scope.
The hill grade comes from the original regional open elevation source. Individual rocks and adjacent landscaping are simplified.
